_schema_notes.coverage: Authoritative schema for all DID formats — DD Form 1664 (pre-2014) and free-text (post-2014 MIL-STD-963C)
_schema_notes.did_format: Set to 'dd_form_1664' or 'free_text'. Determines which fields are expected to be populated.
_schema_notes.963c_compliant: True if the DID was prepared under MIL-STD-963C (2014 or later). False for older DIDs.
_schema_notes.reserved_fields: Fields marked RESERVED are present in one format but not the other. Always include them — set to empty string or empty array when not applicable.
_schema_notes.preparation_instructions: Official MIL-STD-963C name for what was previously called 'requirements'. Contains the numbered sections of the DID. All section numbers are normalized to strictly numeric dot-notation (1, 1.1, 1.1.1). Letter-based source numbering (2.a, 3.1.b) is converted to numeric equivalents (2.1, 3.1.2).
_schema_notes.asterisk: True if the requirement number is followed by * in the source document (conditional requirement).

title: Part Configuration Analysis Report
summary: Specifies the format and content for a Part Configuration Analysis Report used to evaluate and determine the inherent reliability designed into each electrical part used in a high reliability program.
use_relationship:
The purpose of this analysis is to evaluate and determine the inherent reliability designed into each part used in a high reliability program.

The report shall separately cover each electrical part type and number. Parts that are from the same vendor and are identically constructed may be combined under one report. Only one report is required per part number but any change in construction of a part will require an update of the configuration analysis for that part.

This Data Item Description (DID) contains the format and content preparation instructions for the data product generated by the specific and discrete task requirement as delineated in the contract and NSA Standard Number 77-46, "Configuration Analysis" (entire document).
distribution_statement: DISTRIBUTION STATEMENT A: Approved for public release; distribution is unlimited.

preparation_instructions.title: Reference Documents
preparation_instructions.content: The applicable issue of the documents cited herein, including their approval dates and dates of any applicable amendments, notices, and revisions, shall be as stated herein. NSA Standard Number 77-46, "Configuration Analysis," current edition, is available at NSA/I5224, Information Management Services, 9800 Savage Rd, Suite 6718, Fort Meade, Md. 20755-6718.

preparation_instructions.title: Format
preparation_instructions.content: The report shall be in the contractor's format.

preparation_instructions.title: Content
preparation_instructions.content: The Part Configuration Analysis Report shall contain the following information:

children.title: Title page
children.content: The report shall contain a title page for each electrical part type and number, and the following information.

children.title: Report title, including equipment designator in capital letters
Part numbers covered by the report
Date code of the part dissected
Name of author and official title
Approval official name, signature and title
Photographs
children.content: The following photographs shall be included in the report.

children.title: Device cut-a-way sketch and itemized table of materials
children.content: The sketch shall be labeled to illustrate where the materials from the table are located on the sketch.

children.title: Manufacturer's process flow
children.content: The report shall include a block diagram of the manufacturer's process flow.
